statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain header 'Ordinance Nos, 20 of 1931 22 of 1932 31 of 1933 Act Nos, 22 of 1955 23 of 1996'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py on 2026-09-05 into a 33-section tree with 9 definitions and 2 source footnotes; no schedules are transcribed although the First and Second Schedules are referenced. Other sources inspected: the LankaLaw text-layer PDF of Cap. 299 (chain to 22 of 1955, 32 sections), used as the verification source; the section index (33 sections, identical numbers); both held amending files, whose title pages were read from the scans; the 23 of 1996 HTML. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 23 of 1996. Review performed: all 32 pre-1996 section numbers located as section starts in the print; every marginal note read against the HTML heading, with sections 4, 5 and 6 corrected to the print and the HTML reading kept in heading_raw; last provision of the five longest sections (5, 6, 4, 11, 24) read against the print, where 5's last provision 5(8) postdates the print and was read against the 23 of 1996 HTML instead and 5(7) matched word for word; validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and every remaining warning is documented in the trees. Not read word for word throughout. Amendment coverage: 4 instruments in the chain; 22 of 1932 and 31 of 1933 not held; 22 of 1955 (omnibus) and 23 of 1996 held and already incorporated in the baseline, so nothing was applied. Tree included for 23 of 1996 (HTML); its `amends` was filled from the long title. Structural weaknesses: section 5(7) is damaged identically in both editions ('no subsection settlement notice', 'at any lime', 'livery such declaration', 'reading to such notice') and is kept as held; the 23 of 1996 amending tree drops the quoted body of inserted section 5A, which is held only in the consolidated tree; the amending Act cites the principal as Chapter 468 while the PDF is headed Cap. 299. Section count discrepancy: index 33 = HTML 33; PDF 32 because it predates section 5A. Missing sources: Ordinances 22 of 1932 and 31 of 1933; a Government Printer text of the principal Ordinance; the schedules. Unresolved questions: the true wording of the damaged words in 5(7). Lawyer verification: unverified.
